title: China buying twice more gold than officially reported amid surge in central bank purchases
summary:
China's undisclosed gold purchases may signal a strategic reserve shift, potentially impacting global gold prices and market dynamics.
The post China buying twice more gold than officially reported amid surge in central bank purchases appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Reports indicate that China is acquiring significantly more gold than the figures officially disclosed by the central bank. This surge in undisclosed accumulation suggests a strategic shift in the nation's reserve policy. Analysts believe these substantial purchases could have meaningful implications for global gold prices and long-term market dynamics as Beijing continues to adjust its holdings. Crypto Briefing noted that these trends are increasingly drawing international attention.

title: Crypto market rally stalls as optimism fades over US regulatory bill
summary:
The fading optimism over US crypto regulation highlights the ongoing uncertainty and volatility in the crypto market, impacting investor confidence.
The post Crypto market rally stalls as optimism fades over US regulatory bill appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The recent rally in the cryptocurrency market has stalled as investor optimism wanes regarding the status of a pending US regulatory bill. Market participants are showing increased caution due to persistent uncertainty surrounding government oversight. This shift in sentiment underscores the inherent volatility of the industry, as stakeholders monitor legislative developments in the United States to determine the future impact on digital asset valuations and broader market stability.

title: China’s economy shows signs of weakness as investment slumps to new lows
summary:
China's economic slowdown, marked by declining investment and consumption, risks exacerbating global supply-demand imbalances and deflationary pressures.
The post China’s economy shows signs of weakness as investment slumps to new lows appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: China is currently facing significant economic challenges as investment levels decline to record lows. This persistent slowdown in economic activity, coupled with weakened consumption, has raised alarms regarding global supply-demand imbalances. Analysts are concerned that these structural weaknesses in the Chinese market may lead to broader deflationary pressures worldwide, negatively impacting global economic recovery efforts and increasing market uncertainty.

The post CoinEx Sets December Deadline for Withdrawals as Exchange Winds Down appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Cryptocurrency exchange CoinEx is shutting down operations after nine years. The Hong Kong-based platform stopped accepting new user registrations on Tuesday and will fully terminate its services by December 22. Company officials cited a persistent market downturn, reduced trading volume, and unsustainable compliance costs as the primary drivers behind the decision to exit the market. Users are urged to complete their withdrawals before the final December deadline.

summary:

content: Gas prices in California have climbed to $6 per gallon, adding to the growing financial burden of residents. As household expenses rise, there is increasing speculation that these economic pressures could bolster support for new wealth tax proposals across the state, influencing the broader political landscape in California.
